summary: Reuse unchanged PTY registry metadata across reconciliation passes

rules.detail: Control actions continue to read fresh metadata and check daemon identity independently of the incremental snapshot.

compatibility.detail: No wire or client contract change.

recovery.detail: Snapshots reuse unchanged metadata and preserve fresh exited-daemon identity for scope teardown fencing. Exited records read a listed PID sidecar only when metadata lacks daemonPid, retaining legacy ownership conservatively. Output and environment payloads are not retained.
